headline: Chinese Yuan Reaches Three-Week High Supported by Strong PBOC Fixing
summary: The spot onshore Chinese yuan firmed to 6.6611 per dollar, reaching a three-week high as a strong People's Bank of China midpoint fixing and corporate dollar selling offset broader greenback gains.
why: The People's Bank of China manages the onshore currency via a daily fixing mechanism to guide exchange rate stability.

impacts.name: Chinese Yuan
impacts.why: The yuan appreciated to a three-week high against the US dollar following a firm PBOC midpoint fixing.
